parsed.post: LR 0.05 kept: 1.0554 -> 1.0429, new verified best. Testing 0.04. On '0-10': if it excluded shard 10 it would match the baseline config (1.104), yet it scored 0.950 — so it must include EVAL_SHARD=10 (train-on-val leakage). Don't adopt b15e81c.
parsed.description: MATRIX_LR 0.05 -> 0.04: LR keeps improving as it drops (0.10: 1.0953, 0.08: 1.0757, 0.06: 1.0554, 0.05: 1.0429); continue bracketing the optimum from below
parsed.report_to_operator: Follow-up on round-4 escalation: agent-0 still recommends TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10'. If that range excluded shard 10, the result would equal the baseline config (1.104), but it scored 0.950 — strong evidence it trains on EVAL_SHARD=10 (val). Please verify shard indexing.
